name: Jordan Pedersen
bio: Clinical Assistant Professor of Physical Therapy at Clarkson and a Fellow of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Manual Physical Therapists (FAAOMPT) — a credential held by fewer than 1% of US physical therapists when he earned it in 2019. A board-certified orthopaedic specialist also certified in Mechanical Diagnosis and Therapy, he previously practiced at Claxton-Hepburn Medical Center in Ogdensburg, where he was reported as the only PT in St. Lawrence County holding MDT certification.
